title: UFO said to hover over channeling sessions

tellings.quote: right now, there's a a UFO that's sort of hovering over this session and and some claim to have witnessed that.

plain: An unnamed researcher on a podcast describes sessions in the 1970s at the lab of Andrija Puharich, a scientist who studied psychic claims, where young people called the "space kids" would channel, meaning speak messages said to come from beings beyond Earth. According to the researcher, during one session it was announced that a UFO was hovering over them, and some people claim they saw it. If true, it would tie the messages to a real craft overhead.
